notes.title: Chicken Cannon is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
My first ever public project has been released, and you're gonna hate me for creating this after you try it!

[i]Nobody was able to beat this game during development...[/i]
[b]Get it now and try to be the first person to beat it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41064627/9a79f7b3fc8444e81b09f890aff10218b442a2f4.gif[/img]
[h3]Buy Chicken Cannon now, and get ready to get angry![/h3]
